name: Factory Knowledge Classification

classes.definition: Non-negotiable safety, truth or integrity rule whose violation invalidates the work.
Factory or project rule chosen for consistency, risk control or operating discipline.
Useful default or warning threshold that may be overridden by evidence or project context.
Version-sensitive external fact, command, standard, product surface or dependency behavior that must be checked against current authoritative sources before consequential use.
Reusable conceptual technique that must be adapted to the actual stack and constraints.

rules: Numeric thresholds imported from third parties default to HEURISTIC unless they are explicitly tied to a current external standard.
Tool/vendor setup instructions default to VOLATILE_REFERENCE.
A VOLATILE_REFERENCE cannot be promoted to INVARIANT by repetition in multiple prompts.
External standards record name, version/date and authoritative source provenance.
Skill Foundry must classify imported rules before approval.
